papers.headline: Model-Independent Assessments of Tidal Alignment and Density-Weighting Dependence in Galaxy Intrinsic Alignments
papers.summary: Intrinsic alignments (IA) of galaxies are an important source of systematic uncertainty in weak gravitational lensing measurements and also serve as a test for models of galaxy formation and evolution.
papers.title: Model-Independent Assessments of Tidal Alignment and Density-Weighting Dependence in Galaxy Intrinsic Alignments

papers.headline: Nova V1674 Her as a fast magnetic rotator
papers.summary: We report on the results of our XMM-Newton and NuSTAR campaign targeting V1674 Her in October 2023.
papers.title: Nova V1674 Her as a fast magnetic rotator
papers.authors: G. J. M. Luna et al.

papers.headline: Distinguishing N₂₋Dominated from O₂₋Dominated Atmospheres on Terrestrial Exoplanets with Reflected-Light Spectroscopy
papers.summary: Reflected-light spectra of Earth-sized exoplanets promise to probe habitability and biosignatures, but interpreting atmospheric oxygen can be challenging because O₂ can arise from both biological and abiotic processes.
papers.title: Distinguishing N₂₋Dominated from O₂₋Dominated Atmospheres on Terrestrial Exoplanets with Reflected-Light Spectroscopy
papers.authors: N. Burri, M. Damiano, R. Hu
